name: Incoming matters
definition: Matters added to the active caseload during the reporting period, with filed and reactivated components separately identifiable where possible
comparability_notes: Case/application/child count unit must match

name: Resolved matters
definition: Matters reaching the source-defined disposition during the reporting period
comparability_notes: Disposition definition and reopened matters must be documented

name: Pending matters
definition: Active unresolved matters at a specified date
comparability_notes: Active and inactive pending must not be combined without a flag

name: Clearance rate
definition: Resolved matters divided by incoming matters for the same period and compatible case definition
comparability_notes: Prefer recomputation only when components are definitionally aligned

name: Age distribution of active pending caseload
definition: Distribution of elapsed time from filing/start event to measurement date for unresolved active matters
comparability_notes: Age bands may require restricted comparison

name: Median filing-to-disposition time
definition: Median elapsed time from filing/start event to final source-defined disposition
comparability_notes: Completed cohort and exclusions required

name: Mean filing-to-disposition time
definition: Mean elapsed time from filing/start event to final source-defined disposition
comparability_notes: Never substitute for median or pool without distribution information

name: 90th percentile filing-to-disposition time
definition: Elapsed time by which 90% of completed matters are disposed
comparability_notes: Preferred tail indicator where published

name: Completed within time standard
definition: Proportion of matters completed within the jurisdiction-defined time standard
comparability_notes: Standard length and exclusions must travel with value

name: Ready-to-first-available-hearing wait
definition: Prospective wait from a matter being ready/requested for hearing to the first routinely available date
comparability_notes: Not comparable to completed-case duration

name: Filing-to-first substantive hearing
definition: Elapsed time from filing to first substantive judicial hearing
comparability_notes: Define substantive and treatment of urgent/interim events

name: Urgent protection decision time
definition: Elapsed time from application for urgent protective relief to first decision
comparability_notes: Legal urgency standards differ materially

name: Adjournment/continuance rate
definition: Adjourned or continued listed events as a proportion of eligible listed events
comparability_notes: Event-level measure; reason categories valuable

name: Hearings per resolved matter
definition: Number of judicial hearing events per resolved matter
comparability_notes: Case complexity and event coding differ

name: Mediation referral rate
definition: Eligible matters referred to court-connected or mandated mediation
comparability_notes: Specify pre-court versus in-court service

name: Mediation settlement rate
definition: Referred/attended matters reaching full or partial settlement through mediation
comparability_notes: Denominator and partial settlement definition required

name: Self-representation rate
definition: Parties or matters without legal representation at a defined stage
comparability_notes: Party-level and matter-level rates are distinct

name: Legal aid coverage
definition: Eligible parties or matters receiving publicly funded legal assistance
comparability_notes: Eligibility and service scope differ

name: Consent disposition rate
definition: Resolved matters ending by consent/agreement rather than contested determination
comparability_notes: Withdrawal and administrative closure should be separate

name: Withdrawal/dismissal rate
definition: Resolved matters withdrawn, dismissed or administratively closed, with categories separate where possible
comparability_notes: Manner-of-disposal categories must be mapped cautiously

name: Appeal rate
definition: Appeals filed from eligible final decisions
comparability_notes: Appeal rights and time windows differ

name: Reversal or material variation rate
definition: Appeals resulting in reversal, remittal or material variation
comparability_notes: Outcome taxonomy and selection effects required

name: Return to court within 12 months
definition: Families, parties or matters with a new eligible filing within 12 months of final disposition
comparability_notes: Requires stable linkage unit and explicit same-family definition

name: Enforcement application rate
definition: Eligible final orders followed by an enforcement/non-compliance application
comparability_notes: Enforcement pathways may be administrative rather than judicial

name: Placement stability
definition: Children remaining in a stable care/guardianship placement over a defined follow-up period
comparability_notes: Requires child-level linkage and care-system definitions

name: Reunification rate
definition: Children reunified with parent(s) after public-law proceedings within a defined period
comparability_notes: Legal and care-status definitions differ

name: Repeat protection proceeding
definition: Families or protected persons with a subsequent eligible protection-order application within a defined period
comparability_notes: Safety interpretation requires caution

name: Perceived procedural fairness
definition: Court users reporting fair treatment, voice, understanding and respectful process using a documented instrument
comparability_notes: Instrument, response rate and mode required

name: User satisfaction
definition: Court-user satisfaction with service or process
comparability_notes: Satisfaction is not equivalent to fairness or substantive outcome

name: Timeliness disparity
definition: Difference or ratio in compatible timeliness measures between defined population groups
comparability_notes: Group definitions, suppression and confounding required

name: Judicial resources
definition: Judicial full-time-equivalent capacity assigned to family matters
comparability_notes: Allocation methods differ; headcount is not FTE

name: Family-justice expenditure
definition: Public expenditure attributable to family-justice courts/services in the reporting period
comparability_notes: Price level, scope and institutional boundaries required
